demo-narration.description: Narrate approved demonstration text using the host speech provider.

config.instructions: Read the supplied words only. Sound like an interested colleague giving a practical demonstration: conversational, engaged and clear. Vary intonation, emphasize choices and results, and use natural pauses so the listener can follow. Keep the delivery grounded and unhurried.

synthesize.description: Generate a short narration beat as a session-owned WAV artifact.
